## Professional summary

Full-Stack Developer and Multimedia Engineer with 5+ years of experience across logistics, energy, fintech, education and SaaS. Works end-to-end: requirements, relational data modeling, backend APIs, frontend interfaces, automated tests, containers and deployment. Strong in Java 21 / Spring Boot, Angular / React, PHP / Yii2, Node.js, PostgreSQL / SQL Server and automated testing. Comfortable owning a module or a complete product, and documents and tests what he builds.

## Core skills

- Backend: Java 21, Spring Boot, Spring Security, JPA/Hibernate, Node.js/Express, PHP/Yii2, Python/Django, NestJS.
- Frontend: Angular 18, React, TypeScript, Ionic, PWA, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap.
- Data: PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL/MariaDB, Redis, MongoDB, Flyway, TypeORM, Sequelize.
- DevOps and QA: Docker, Nginx, Git, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Linux, JUnit 5, Mockito, Selenium, Codeception, Playwright.
- Integrations: DIAN / UBL 2.1, XAdES-EPES, SIESA ERP, Wompi, Stripe, WhatsApp Cloud API, JWT / OAuth2, REST APIs.
- Architecture: hexagonal architecture, domain-driven design, modular monoliths, multi-tenant SaaS.
- Other: Unity, C#, Vuforia, Photoshop, Premiere, After Effects.

2026 – present · Software studio · codevam.dev · Cali, Colombia · Remote

## Selected projects

- VamCore — CodeVam's modular enterprise platform: Java 21 / Spring Boot modular monolith, Angular 18, PostgreSQL, Flyway, Docker, hexagonal architecture, DDD and domain events. Powers three products: VamStock (inventory), VamAsset (fixed assets) and VamTrack (delivery logistics). Shared identity, multi-tenant organization, audit, files, notifications and reporting modules. 3 products, 15 REST controllers, 9 migrations.
- CodeVam Fiscal — DIAN electronic invoicing platform for Colombia: Java 21 / Spring Boot 3.3.5, Angular 22 PWA, PostgreSQL 16, Flyway, XAdES-EPES digital signatures and UBL 2.1 documents; batch processing, per-tenant API keys, wallet, document management and admin portal. 326 tests, 92.25% instruction coverage, 10 portal modules, 15 migrations.
- VamPOS — Multi-tenant, offline-first POS for Colombian stores: Angular 18 + Ionic 8 PWA, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Redis, DIAN-ready documents and B2B API. 23 migrations.
- Vecindad — Multi-tenant property management: Spring Boot, PostgreSQL schema-per-tenant, Redis, Flyway, JWT, Wompi, reservations, PQRS and visitor management. 83 unit tests and 20 smoke sections.
- FruverCopilot — AI-assisted WhatsApp ordering platform for a fruit-and-vegetable business. 39 tests.
- GRUMALOG — Warehouse management system for wholesale distribution: PHP/Yii2, SQL Server, SIESA ERP integration, EAN13 generation and multi-barcode SKU models. 8 operational modules: inbound, counting, transfers, cross-docking, outbound, store receiving and returns.
- SIGE — Energization management platform for an energy company: 7 applications to plan, track and weather-monitor energization schedules.
- GES — Security operations and quadrants system: 9 controllers and 67 views.
- Celsia One / SAGES-ISA — Energy sector platforms: frontend contribution to Celsia One and support for SAGES/ISA (74 controllers, 151 views).
- Coopcarvajal — Elecciones & Entregax — Technical continuity for two pre-existing Yii2 systems used by Coopcarvajal: Elecciones (electoral platform, MariaDB) and Entregax (delivery operations and driver settlements, MySQL 8). Role: CI/CD pipeline, Codeception suite, coverage setup, database support, module adjustments and the 2027 assembly technical plan. Not original authorship; 10/10 tests.
- Dr. Jiménez — Dental platform: 3 portals, 10 tables and 9 migrations.
- CubeLearn — Thesis project (2021): augmented-reality educational game to teach programming logic to teenagers using Unity, C#, Vuforia and physical AR markers.
